title: Wireframe a premium landing page
description: Create desktop and mobile text wireframes.
accomplishes: Create desktop and mobile text wireframes. State the purpose, essential content and action of every section. Specify form states and mobile reordering. Include testimonials only when supplied and define a comprehension test for the offer and next step.
prompt:
Act as a senior product designer.

Task: Wireframe a premium landing page.

Input context:
- OFFER: [OFFER]
- AUDIENCE: [AUDIENCE]
- PRIMARY ACTION: [PRIMARY ACTION]
- AVAILABLE EVIDENCE: [AVAILABLE EVIDENCE]

Create desktop and mobile text wireframes. State the purpose, essential content and action of every section. Specify form states and mobile reordering. Include testimonials only when supplied and define a comprehension test for the offer and next step.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Photography workshop wireframe
Hero: audience, learning objective and “View dates.” Follow with three practice outcomes, equipment requirements, confirmed terms and a registration form. On mobile, put the programme immediately after the hero. An invalid date receives a specific correction. Ask a test reader to explain who it is for, what is included and what happens next.
